description: Common ApprovalRequest contract for EXTERNAL gated actions (Cursor export, later MAIL).

fields.payload_hash: sha256 hex of approved bytes (no self-referential hash)
fields.resource_version: integer resource version at approval time
fields.author: string

rules: Grant/refuse are human governance commands — not themselves EXTERNAL requiring recursive GO.
Export/send execution must verify granted non-expired matching hash+version then consume once.
Content change invalidates pending/granted approvals for that resource version.
Replayed create with same idempotency key returns the same approval.
